_note: A sky full of homesteads (docs/DESIGN.md, The cap's off): small claims and beacons out in the system, drawn on the system map (view/homesteads.gd). View-only: the sim never sees them. 'named' have a name and who lives there, on a circular orbit about a body (r_km about a planet, a_au about the Sun) at a phase picked by hashing the name. 'scatter' fills each region with unnamed small claims (count, between radii), their beacon names built from first and second.
